items.name: Rice Cake
items.desc: Sweet and filling. Restores 50 HP to one ally.

items.name: Plum Tonic
items.desc: Sour enough to wake the dead, nearly. Restores 200 HP to one ally.

items.name: Pot of Pine Tea
items.desc: One pot, three cups. Restores 80 HP to the whole party.

items.name: Festival Bento
items.desc: Packed for a feast that never came. Restores 250 HP to the whole party.

items.name: Inkstone Chip
items.desc: Grind it, wet it, and the brush drinks. Adds 25 Vermilion Ink to one ally.

items.name: Pot of Fresh Ink
items.desc: Rich and dark, still smelling of pine soot. Adds 50 Vermilion Ink to one ally.

items.name: Paper Firecracker
items.desc: Festival leftovers. Bursts for 60 Ember damage on one foe.

items.name: Thunder Jar
items.desc: Grandmother Tsuru won't say what's inside. Bursts for 150 Gale damage on one foe.

equipment.name: Red-Cord Katana
equipment.desc: A brush-handled blade bound with a red cord. Every cut leaves a trail of ink.

equipment.name: Prayer-Slip Bow
equipment.desc: A tall shrine bow hung with prayer slips that flutter when it sings.

equipment.name: Iron-Banded Staff
equipment.desc: Old temple oak bound in iron. Heavy, honest, and hard to break.

equipment.name: Seal-Edge Katana
equipment.desc: Its blade is stamped with a fresh red seal. It cuts clean through smudge.

equipment.name: Crane-Feather Bow
equipment.desc: Fletched with feathers shed by the shrine's paper cranes. Its arrows never wander.

equipment.name: Bell-Bronze Staff
equipment.desc: Capped with bronze from a cracked temple bell. It hums when it strikes.

equipment.name: Layered Washi Vest
equipment.desc: Oiled paper, folded and stitched in layers. Tougher than it looks.

equipment.name: Lacquered Haori
equipment.desc: A coat lacquered black and lined with blessed paper. Ink beads right off it.

equipment.name: Prayer-Bead Mala
equipment.desc: Beads the size of plums. Counting them steadies the breath.

equipment.name: Folded Paper Charm
equipment.desc: A shrine charm folded into a crane. Clip it somewhere it can see you.

equipment.name: Lantern Bell
equipment.desc: A tiny brass bell from a shrine lantern. Its ring keeps the grey at bay.
